The Problem

A broken process before it even started

Interested visitors had nowhere compelling to land. Forms collected the wrong data. And once someone signed up — silence. No confirmation, no next steps, no follow-up. Potential attendees were slipping through the cracks simply because the system wasn't built to hold them.

Landing Page

Conversion-focused first impression

A clean, structured landing page with a strong headline, value proposition, social proof from 150+ students, and a single clear CTA — built to move visitors from curiosity to registration.

Live Landing Page — HubSpot CRM Bootcamp
Registration Form

Structured data capture with zero friction

A multi-field form collecting name, email, experience level, and referral source — each field deliberate. Required fields kept lean to reduce drop-off while capturing quality lead data for segmentation.

Registration Form — Structured for CRM Segmentation
Email Automation

Instant, personalised confirmation — zero manual effort

The moment a form was submitted, a branded confirmation email fired automatically — personalised with the registrant's first name, bootcamp dates, Zoom access, and clear next steps.

Thank You Page

Sealing the experience with clarity

Post-registration, users landed on a custom thank-you page confirming their spot, showing bootcamp details, and offering a one-click calendar add. No ambiguity — just confidence they were in.

Seamless. Automatic. Trust-building from click one.

When students can't get help, they leave

05
Lead Generation · Outreach · Conversion

Lead Generation & Outreach System for Kelziconcepts Ltd

Good services don't sell themselves. KelziConcepts had no structured system for identifying qualified leads, reaching out strategically, or following up with enough consistency to convert.

Kelziconcepts Ltd
Google Sheets & Outreach
Lead Gen & Conversion
10 qualified leads + system
View Live Project
The Problem

Good services — no system to sell them

KelziConcepts had no structured system for outreach. Without a lead database, a follow-up sequence, or social proof baked into messaging, even good services get ignored. Outreach was either absent or generic — and generic doesn't convert.

Lead Database

10 real leads. Every one chosen with intention.

I researched and compiled a database of 10 qualified leads in Google Sheets — each selected for genuine fit with KelziConcepts' services. No filler. Every entry included the prospect's name, business, contact information, identified need, and reason for fit. Quality over quantity, from the very first row.

📋 Name & business details 📧 Contact information 🎯 Identified need & fit score
Outreach Sequence

3 messages. Each one sharper than the last.

I designed a 3-step outreach sequence built around progressive personalization — an introduction and value offer on Day 1, a follow-up reminder on Day 3, and a stronger, more tailored close on Day 7. Each touchpoint felt like a conversation, not a campaign. And woven through every message: social proof tied specifically to KelziConcepts' services — reliability, past results, and client success stories — because trust closes deals, not just words.

1️⃣
Day 1 — Introduction + Value

Clear positioning, what KelziConcepts offers, and why it's relevant to this specific prospect.

2️⃣
Day 3 — Follow-up + Reminder

A softer nudge that reinforces value and keeps the conversation alive without pressure.

3️⃣
Day 7 — Final + Personalization

The strongest message — most tailored, most direct, backed by social proof and a clear call to action.

The Result

Not just leads — a repeatable system for getting them

KelziConcepts now has a qualified lead database, a reusable 3-step outreach sequence, and a social proof strategy built around their actual services. The work didn't just produce leads — it built the infrastructure to keep producing them.

✓ 10 verified, qualified leads ✓ 3-step sequence ready to deploy ✓ Social proof integrated ✓ Reusable & scalable system ✓ Personalization at every touchpoint

Calendly Scheduling System for CloudMita Consultancy LTD

A consultancy with no clean way to book clients. The process was manual, fragmented, and unreliable — costing them time, appointments, and trust with every missed touchpoint.

CloudMita Consultancy LTD
Calendly + Google Meet
Scheduling Automation
Fully automated bookings
The Problem

Booking a consultation shouldn't feel like a full-time job

CloudMita had clients to serve — but no clean way to book them. No automated meeting links, no reminders, no follow-ups. Every booking was a potential missed appointment or a frustrated client. The system wasn't just inefficient — it was costing them trust.

Availability & Scheduling Setup

Structured availability. Zero conflicts.

I configured real-time Google Calendar sync so availability was always accurate, and set structured availability windows — Monday to Friday, 9AM to 4PM. No double bookings, no guesswork.

Availability Schedule — Mon–Fri, 09:00–16:00 WAT
Event Types & Booking Experience

Two event types. One seamless experience.

I created two custom event types: a 30-minute one-on-one consultation and a 45-minute group strategy session with invitee limits. Google Meet was set as the default location — every confirmed booking generated a meeting link automatically.

Executive VA Consultation — Client Booking View
Scheduling Dashboard — Event Types Overview
Integrations & Automation

Every touchpoint automated — nothing left to chance

I connected Google Calendar and Google Meet, then built the full automation layer: host reminders, invitee reminders, booking confirmation emails, and post-event follow-up sequences. Every step in the client journey was covered and verified with live test bookings.

Integrations — Google Calendar & Google Meet Connected
The Result

From manual chaos to a booking system that runs itself

CloudMita went from a manual, error-prone process to a fully automated scheduling system that runs without anyone touching it. Clients book, get a confirmation, receive reminders, join via Google Meet, and get a follow-up — all automatically. The business looked more professional from the very first interaction.
